name: Tennis Coach

pf.license.need: No state license for coaching. The business registers as the state's rules require (registration only). The practice's own word, not checked by Rosie.
pf.license.who holds it: The business: its registration, where required. Coaches: no license.
pf.license.checks for coaches who teach children: A background check and abuse-prevention training that the business keeps on its own record before a coach is booked with a child (the business's own rule). Rosie doesn't check them; the business says so.
pf.license.certifications: Teaching certifications (from tennis or pickleball associations) are shown only when the coach or the business says so. Rosie does not check them.
pf.license.insurance: Liability insurance is the business's own record; a club may ask to see it.

stops the booking or the lesson.words: Someone collapsed, chest pain, can't breathe, or a head injury with confusion
stops the booking or the lesson.says: Call 911 now. The club's AED is at the front desk.
stops the booking or the lesson.booking: The lesson stops; no booking until they say it's handled.

stops the booking or the lesson.says: Everyone off the court and indoors or in a car. Play waits 30 minutes after the last thunder.
stops the booking or the lesson.booking: The lesson stops; it's moved, with no fee.

stops the booking or the lesson.words: Heat illness: dizzy, sick, confused, or stopped sweating
stops the booking or the lesson.says: Stop, get to shade, sip water. Call 911 if they're confused or faint.

safety steps, then the booking goes on.says: Book a light session; the coach reads the note on the secure page first.

before the first lesson.step: A waiver signed on the secure page (a parent signs for a child)
before the first lesson.late: not signed: signed at the court before play, or the lesson doesn't start

pf.first_steps.prep for the reminder: Court shoes, water, a hat, and a racquet or paddle (a loaner is free).

pf.visit.check-in: The check-in code at the court; the coach enters it. Clinics: names on a roster.
pf.visit.children: A private lesson with a child: a parent, or an adult they name, stays on site. Kids' clinics: children may be left, and are handed back only to an adult the parent named.
pf.visit.changes at the lesson: Extending a lesson by 30 minutes when the court is free: priced first, and the player's yes.
pf.visit.weather: Rain, wet courts, lightning or extreme heat: the coach makes the call, up to 2 hours before or at the court. A rainout is moved or cancelled with no fee, and a pack lesson goes back to the pack.
pf.visit.stopped by weather partway: Under half the lesson done: a free make-up lesson. Half or more done: it counts as given (the example coach's rule).

pf.money.Rosfield's $2: $2 per confirmed booking, a flat fee for each booking Rosie makes. It applies here too (D97).
pf.money.private lessons: Paid in full when booked (the main way), or a card saved and charged at DONE, or paid at the court on the coach's phone.
pf.money.packs: A 5-lesson pack bought on the page; each lesson then uses one. Good for 6 months (the coach's own term, told at purchase). No reminder from Rosie.
pf.money.clinics: A seat paid in full when booked.
pf.money.weekly lessons: A repeat plan with its own yes: a card saved, charged after each lesson.
pf.money.late cancel and no-show: Inside 24 hours, or a no-show: the full lesson kept, or a pack lesson used, only with the coach's yes.
pf.money.rainouts: No fee. A paid lesson moves or is refunded; a pack lesson goes back to the pack.
pf.money.tips and codes: No tip line. No discount codes.
pf.money.reserved time: A lesson is the coach's reserved court time: a player who arrives late or stops early pays the full price, and nothing comes back for time not used (S13-55's reserved-time line).

pf.messages.never in a text: Injuries and health notes, a child's details, and who may pick a child up.
pf.messages.minors: Texts about a child's lesson or clinic go to the parent.

pf.staff.people: The head coach (the owner) and assistant coaches. No license; the business's own word on each coach's background check.
pf.staff.supervision: Anyone who coaches children has a cleared background check and abuse-prevention training on file. A child is never alone with one adult out of sight of others (the business's own rule).
pf.staff.stand-ins: Another coach with the same skill (and the child checks, for a child). A player who named their coach moves only with their yes.

pf.rules.waiver: A signed waiver before the first lesson.
pf.rules.child safety: Background checks and training for coaches who teach children, the business's own record; lessons with a child in an open place others can see; no one-on-one contact with a child off the court (the business's own rules, from the programs it belongs to).
pf.rules.weather: The coach makes the weather call; a rainout is never charged.
pf.rules.fees: Late-cancel and no-show: the coach's own rule, asked each time.

pf.edges.all: Every edge case is handled the general way. These matter most here:
coaching: Rain, wet courts, lightning or extreme heat: moved or cancelled, no fee; a pack lesson goes back
The court isn't free (the club closed it or double-booked it): moved, no fee
The player runs late: the lesson still ends on time; the price stands
Stopped partway by weather: a make-up when under half was done
A clinic with fewer than 4: the coach runs it or cancels; everyone gets their seat back
A child not picked up after a clinic: the coach waits with the child and calls the parent
A pack runs out in 6 months: the coach's own term, told at purchase; Rosie sends no reminder for it
A player gets hurt: first aid; 911 when needed

more: A short list of the few rules businesses like this usually set, ranked by the plug-in. Each row shows only where it applies.
Words: 'Businesses like yours often set these. Your call.' Never 'the law requires'.
Sam keeps them, unticks one, or taps one to change it. Each kept one becomes Sam's own rule.
Rows cover hours, cancel and any fee, same-day and new customers, and price OKs.
A fee row shows only where a card, a deposit or the full price is taken. It sets one late-cancel and no-show fee per booking.
When money was paid now, the fee is never more than what was paid now.
A fee is asked of Sam each time, never charged on silence.
For sensitive work, the suggested fee is $0: no fee unless Sam sets one.
Price OKs: quotes and bills over an amount come to the owner first. List prices never need an OK.
Sam's OK rules for requests are read at booking (A4-98 and B4-115). They cover same day, new customers, some services or dates.
A STOP before the pro sets out: the pro calls first. No answer in 15 minutes: the pro sets out.
Phone line: missed and after-hours calls go to Rosie's voice assistant. Every call opens with S13-01's words.
A call summary comes by text. A call only a person can take goes to a put-through number, never the owner's own mobile.
The phone-line row asks once for it: a staff phone or a second line that doesn't forward to Rosie.
Default: none, so the caller gets a callback. One that comes back to Rosie counts as nobody picked up (S13-56).
Kept on, the forwarding card needs one 'Done'. Later: the voice line stays off until it's done.
Bills Rosie sends: a tip line, and bank transfer over an amount, each only where bills are sent.
Where the plug-in allows it, a membership or a repeat plan charged monthly through Rosfield costs 1% of each charge.
It pays no $2 on its visits or members' classes.
A member who pays elsewhere: Rosie can't see it.
So each class they book is $2 at check-in, where the plug-in allows it.
So one row asks: take bookings from members who pay elsewhere? On unless Sam turns it off. Off: those bookings are declined (A4-80).
Not shown, kept at a safe default: the owner's text hours, 8am to 8pm, with same-day requests anytime.
Also months offered, peak dates, terms by customer, reasons with no fee, signed dated schedules and who may book.
Also the waitlist, one bill for many visits and the no-show count, all off. Stand-ins are offered, never on silence.
Each is on the summary (S1-79). Sam changes any by text or a call, or in the portal (S11-56).
Only the business's own customers may book: a row only where the plug-in suggests it. Else Sam sets it by text or a call.
Deposit or fee caps the plug-in knows show as suggested rows. They're the owner's own rules, never Rosie's checks.
Sam's answer clock runs only in Sam's text hours. Same-day requests reach Sam anytime.
Where Sam's OK rules cover it, like a new customer, Sam gets 5 minutes, any hour. Silence sends nobody (B4-115).
A booking keeps the rules it was made with. Every text's arrival and free-cancel times come from these settings.
For a drafted plug-in, the suggestions come from the closest known kinds and the checklist, reviewed with the draft.
Never: charge a fee on silence, or let a suggestion run before the owner keeps it.
Safe default: every suggestion kept as shown, any fee asked each time.
